title: Shattered Gallery
description: A woman in a long purple velvet gown stands in the center of a dark, ornate room with a cracked marble floor. She holds a framed painting that is breaking apart, while a large crystal chandelier hangs above and multiple other framed artworks float or shatter around her, connected by glowing yellow fracture lines.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene of a woman in a long purple velvet evening gown standing in a dark decaying art gallery with a cracked black marble floor. She holds a large broken painting containing multiple faces. A glowing crystal chandelier hangs overhead casting beams of light. Other framed paintings float and shatter around her, connected by bright yellow glowing fracture lines running across the floor and walls.
